headline: Qualcomm (QCOM) Stock Fair Value Moves Lower As Margin Pressure Offsets AI Ambitions
summary: QUALCOMM’s updated fair value estimate has been cut from US$221.23 to US$196.27, trimming roughly 11% from the prior price target. This shift lines up with a research backdrop where bullish AI and data center expectations are being weighed against concerns around handset weakness and margin pressure. As you read on, you will see how these moving targets feed into the evolving QUALCOMM story and how to track the narrative from here. Analyst Price Targets don't always capture the full story...
